<thought>We need the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a Friedel‑Crafts acylation (break the C–C bond to the carbonyl carbon and generate an acyl chloride). The target molecule is provided, but the template ID is not known. We can search the template catalog for templates that break a halide bond and form a C–C bond on an aromatic ring, which should retrieve the appropriate template. Once we have the template ID, we can apply it to the target SMILES to obtain all possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccc(CNc2c(C(=O)Nc3cccc(OC)c3)nnn2Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
